text:
emily: Quick follow-up from the all-hands — thanks for the roadmap clarity. Two asks from my side: (1) what language should PMs use in customer-facing decks about our differentiation vs model-first vendors, and (2) what evidence should go into sales one-pagers for the 'serving-first' thesis?

jorge: For field folks: lead with outcomes not tech. "Predictable cost + reliable latency at scale" beats model spec comparisons in most exec convos. Include a 1-line proof point: "X customers cut inference cost by Y% after switching to Redwood Dedicated."

nina: Can we standardize the competitive callouts? I'm seeing engineering buyers ask about latency guarantees vs the big clouds and about model freshness vs model-hosting vendors.

tom: Suggest two templated callouts: one for performance (SLA, p50/p95/p99 numbers on representative workloads) and one for economics (cost per 1M tokens for typical generator/embedding workloads). Keep model access as secondary: "catalog + compatibility".

priya: For the sales one-pager evidence, what are defensible benchmarks we can publish without leaking customer data? Is synthetic workload benching ok?
dylan: Yes — use standardized bench harnesses (chat small, chat long, embeddings) and provide delta to public baselines. Also include an anonymized case study: % improvements and failure-mode notes. Legal will sign off on anonymization.

emily: Nice. Also — leadership: who owns the canonical competitor matrix and the approved messaging bullets? I'd like one source of truth so PMs don't invent different claims.

jorge: Marketing + GTM will own messaging bullets. Product (nina) + sales (priya) will own competitor matrix. We should put both in the Console > Sales Kit and lock versioning.

ops-bot: Reminder: doc "gof-to-market/serving-first-evidence" created and linked in #resources. :file_folder:

emily: Final ask — could leadership add a short FAQ for engineering teams about when to recommend Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private? Real examples (e.g., "low traffic internal tool -> hosted; regulated payments -> private") would be super helpful.

jorge: Agreed. We'll draft an "ICP & recommendation" one-pager with concrete examples and hand it off to devex to fold into quickstarts. Expect a draft by Friday. :calendar:
